appeal.body: Committee on Open Government (advisory only); Article 78 in state Supreme Court
appeal.rule_text: Administrative appeal to the body's appeals officer, then an Article 78 proceeding in state Supreme Court. Committee on Open Government opinions are advisory, not binding. Appeal clocks were not confirmed from the fetched source.
